messages:
alex: Quick huddle — we need to lock the OKR items for the inference controls/optimization initiative. Focus: what the Optimize kit and evals must deliver for Q3 launch. Short bullets pls.

mika: TL;DR we have 3 customer asks: predictable latency under burst, clear batching/caching guidance, and regression monitoring for prompt sets.

priya: +1 on those. Also customers want a rollout checklist (canary -> fallback) and a minimal perf SLA we can promise for Dedicated.

jon: I propose we rank by customer impact and engineering effort. My initial ranking: 1) regressions & eval harness, 2) batching/caching recommendations + config UI, 3) rollout checklist + SLAs.

alex: I like that. For launch criteria we need concrete gating: acceptance tests, perf bench, docs, and a customer beta. Suggest: 
```
- eval harness: pass all baseline prompt sets, no >5% metric regressions
- perf bench: median p50 latency within SLO for nominated models
- docs: config recipes + 3 example workloads
- beta: at least 2 customers using Dedicated or Hosted with success signals
```

mika: Are we comfortable with the 5% regression threshold? Some prompt sets are noisy. Maybe use weighted metrics or require human review for borderline cases.

priya: Agreed. Let's add an explicit step: if an eval shows a regression between 3-7%, trigger human review and a rollback plan. >7% auto-fails.

jon: For batching/caching guidance: we should ship a decision tree + a small config optimizer (heuristic) in the UI. Example rules: prefer prefix cache for chat, use continuous batching for short requests, and recommend quantization profile per model.

alex: That sounds right. Can we scope the config optimizer to be read-only for launch (suggestions only) and make it writable in the next quarter? Lower risk.

mika: yep. That reduces blast radius. Also add a telemetry gate: token-level cost + latency breakdown must be visible per-route.

priya: Customer asks for one-pager: "How to choose caching vs batching" — I'll own that doc with a couple of workload examples.

alex: Great. Action items: 
- priya: one-pager + 3 prompt sets to include in eval harness (due in 10d)
- jon: prototype config recommender (suggest-only) + decision tree in README (due in 2 wks)
- mika: define regression thresholds + review flow, and telemetry gating (due EOW)
- alex: draft beta customer shortlist and launch checklist (due in 3d)

devrel-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap review meeting scheduled Thu 11:00. Added checklist template to the team drive -> https://drive.redwood/inference/okrs/controls-launch

jon: Quick question — do we want to include an A/B test harness in the first launch or push to Q4? A/B helps validate config suggestions but increases scope.

alex: Push A/B to Q4. Must-have is stable gating + beta. A/B is nice-to-have.

mika: Noted. I'll prepare a short risk memo on rollback mechanisms and perf flakiness scenarios.

priya: I'll post the prompt sets to the eval repo once drafted. Expect a ping.

alex: Thanks team. This is enough to update the OKR doc and estimate sprint scope. We'll reconvene after EOW updates. :thumbsup:
